name: Spacers
summary:
Welcome to Spacers, a Gorilla Tag Fan Game that is themed around space. Explore many unique planets and fight off many aliens invading those planets. If you get bored, you can also play activities in the Activity Center. Either you can play some solo arcade games at the Arcade, or have fun in the multiple Activities!
